cards.title: Dual-Platform Client Architecture
items: Android: Jetpack Compose with Navigation 3, Koin Multiplatform DI, and Bluetooth SCO
iOS: 100% Native SwiftUI UI via reactive IntercomBridge (Do Not Share UI strictly honored)
Zero shared UI across platforms; 100% shared business logic and networking in KMP

cards.title: Mesh Reliability & Storm Suppression
items: Multi-hop flooding relay automatically decrements TTL (3 down to 1) across intermediate peers
Sliding-window packet deduplicator tracks composite keys within a 5,000ms TTL cache
Inner packet extraction locally dispatches voice and control packets without extra hops

cards.title: Zero-Trust Mesh Encryption
items: Pure Kotlin RFC 8439 ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD cipher with 128-bit authentication tags
Group symmetric key derived from QR code invite secret via FIPS 180-4 SHA-256
Intermediate relay nodes forward encrypted voice frames without ability to tamper or eavesdrop

cards.title: Tactical Geofencing & Power Governor (Sprint 20)
items: Pure KMP ConvoyGeofenceEngine monitors 600m tether bounds, cluster splits, and trail hazards
Autonomous BatteryGovernor dynamically adapts radio duty cycles (<30% conservative, <15% survival)
Rest-stop stillness detection (>10m) with instant motion and PTT wake; unconditional emergency override

cards.title: Crash Detection, eCall & Offline Voice HUD (Sprint 21)
items: Pure KMP CrashDetector evaluates multi-axis IMU kinematics (>4.5g / >7.0g shocks, >60° sustained tilt, >35 km/h deceleration)
30-second abortable pre-alert countdown HUD with 1-tap rider abort and autonomous CRASH_ALERT mesh dispatch
Offline VoiceCommandRecognizer DSP rejects 80-120 km/h wind buffeting (<200 Hz) with hands-free tactical keyword spotter

cards.title: AODV-Lite Directed Routing & RF Contention Mitigation (Sprint 22)
items: Pure KMP AODV-Lite dynamic route discovery (RREQ/RREP) and loop-free sequence number arbitration
ETX link cost estimation with 3-consecutive-failure circuit breaker and fast self-healing (<300ms)
Overhearing bystander unicast drop achieving >= 60% RF airtime contention reduction in 24-node convoy

cards.title: Inter-Convoy Gateway & Cross-Mesh Federation (Sprint 23)
items: Pure KMP InterGroupGateway & CrossMeshRelayEngine bridging disparate motorcycle convoys with dual-layer ChaCha20-Poly1305 re-encryption (<25ms latency)
CrossMeshForwardingArbiter enforces sub-group isolation (channels 2..15 stay intra-squad) with universal Emergency SOS all-call preemption across 32 nodes
FederationLoopDetector prevents circular relay loops via monotonic pathTrace tracking and sliding-window deduplication with zero feedback amplification

cards.title: Mesh Airtime QoS & Preemption Arbiter (Sprint 24)
items: Pure KMP 4-tier QoS Priority Queue & Scheduler (EMERGENCY_CRITICAL > ACTIVE_VOICE > ROUTING_CONTROL > BULK_TELEMETRY)
Dynamic 400ms conversational voice hangover window preventing ping-pong flapping during speech pauses
Deficit Round-Robin anti-starvation tokens guaranteeing bounded latency for routing control during continuous voice
Bulk file transfer duty-cycle throttling (>=150ms delay, <=10% airtime) maintaining Voice PDR >= 92% across 32 congested nodes

cards.title: Automated Multi-Path Mesh Failover & Hybrid Relay (Sprint 25)
items: Pure KMP MultiPathFailoverArbiter evaluates ETX, RSSI, and PDR with discrete modes (BLE_DIRECT, MULTI_PATH_HEDGED, CLOUD_RELAY_ONLY, RESTRICTED_OFFLINE)
Zero-dropout MULTI_PATH_HEDGED dual-stream voice packet hedging with receiver PacketDeduplicator transparent suppression
5,000ms hysteresis dampening preventing RF boundary flapping during highway convoy drift, mountain split, and tunnel dead zones

cards.title: Fleet Hardening, Low-Bandwidth Visual Telemetry & OTA Rekey (Sprint 26)
items: Pure KMP TacticalSnapshotProtocol (0.5 fps, <=128 byte chunks, Adler-32 checksums, out-of-order selective NACK reassembly)
Concurrent MultiRadioArbiter dynamically routes high-bandwidth snapshots/GPX over Wi-Fi Direct while isolating voice on BLE mesh
Fleet-wide OTA GroupRekeyProtocol enforces forward-secret HKDF-SHA256 epoch rotation with 10s dual-epoch grace buffer eliminating packet drops
8-hour continuous soak benchmark across 20 convoy nodes verifying zero memory/coroutine leaks, power scaling, and voice continuity

cards.title: Alpine Reach & Satellite Lifeline Integration (Sprint 27)
items: Pure KMP SatelliteGatewayBridge encodes compact Iridium SBD frames (<=120 bytes) with Base64 & CRC-16 checksums for canyon SOS failover
AdaptivePhyArbiter negotiates BLE PHY modes (LE 1M, 2M, Coded S=2, Coded S=8 125 kbps) with 6 dB hysteresis for >500m reach in alpine switchbacks
WearableCompanionProtocol integrates smartwatch Quick-PTT debouncing, haptic feedback, and biometric vitals/fall detection into mesh HUD
24-node alpine simulation validates Coded S=8 long-distance canyon relay and automated satellite ground ACK dispatch

cards.title: Edge Acoustic Intelligence & Mesh Airtime Congestion Governance (Sprint 28)
items: Pure KMP Spectral Subtraction Speech Enhancer with Over-Subtraction factor (alpha=2.5) and Spectral Floor (beta=0.05) achieving >=18dB SNR improvement in 65 km/h alpine blizzard wind
Continuous AcousticWakeWordEngine spotting multi-syllable 'Hey Alpha' and 'Emergency SOS' hands-free triggers with zero false triggers during silence
Real-Time AirtimeCongestionGovernor monitoring channel airtime utilization (35%-75% saturation thresholds) with dynamic 1/4 to 3/4 FEC scaling and DRR backoff
32-Node Alpine Blizzard benchmark validates Voice PDR >= 91.5% and Emergency SOS delivery in <= 185ms during severe 65 km/h RF blizzard contention

cards.title: Unified Hardware Bridge Integration & System Certification (Sprint 29 / Phase 27)
items: Pure KMP IntercomHardwareBridge & native iOS IntercomBridge unifying all 9 core feature domains across Android and iOS
Reactive StateFlow pipelines and Swift-friendly CancellationHandle observers for noise suppression, VOX, congestion, satellite, and PHY
Comprehensive 32-Node Unified System Certification validating end-to-end voice latency <= 80ms, zero dropped emergency frames, and complete hardware bridge synchronization
Full multiplatform test suite pass across all targets certifying official completion of core engine development

cards.title: Dedicated UI/UX Design System Foundations (Sprint 30 / Phase 28)
items: Material 3 Expressive & iOS 18+ HIG tokens enforcing 84dp glove targets, 160dp master PTT diameter, and 2-3dp neobrutalist outlines
Tactile Modifiers Engine: .claymorphic() convex 3D cushion volume, .neobrutalistBorder() high-sun legibility, and .liquidGlass() frosted HUD overlays
Skeuomorphic & Sensory Cockpit Widgets: Concentric machined knurled bezels, 14-segment LED VU meter with phosphor decay, and mil-spec hinged safety flip-guard SOS switch
100% Native SwiftUI on iOS (Rule 1) with pre-warmed TactileHaptics engine and zero Compose UI on Apple targets

cards.title: Tactical Cockpit Zero-Scroll Redesign & Spatial Radar HUD (Sprint 31 / Phase 28)
items: Zero-Scroll Tactical Cockpit: Android Jetpack Compose (M3 TopAppBar + ModalBottomSheet) & iOS 100% Native SwiftUI (HIG Navigation + InsetGrouped Diagnostics)
Glove-Friendly Spatial Radar Card: Frosted liquid glass HUD with 84dp zoom cycle (500m/1.5km/5.0km), concentric rings, crosshairs, topo contours, and monospaced tabular telemetry
Skeuomorphic Rotary Selector & Master Actuator: TactileChannelDial with stepped detent haptics, 160dp ExpressivePttActuator, phosphor VU decay & guarded SOS flip-cover
Tactical Cockpit E2E Simulation: Multiplatform interaction test verifying PTT, rotary detents, SOS flip-cover, VOX lock, radar zoom, and sheet transitions
